description: I am a passionate software engineer specializing in building high-performance, scalable web applications and intuitive digital experiences. Over the past several years, I have architected systems ranging from reactive client-side interfaces to resilient, event-driven distributed microservices.

My engineering philosophy centers on clean architectural design, strict type safety, automated testing, and relentless runtime performance tuning. Whether designing collaborative real-time canvases or optimizing complex database queries, I bridge engineering rigor with human-centered product craft.

Deeply invested in open-source tooling, I regularly share solutions with the developer community and continuously explore modern advancements in cloud infrastructure, systems design, and developer tooling.
